name: robo-taxonomist
description: Effect-based taxonomy reconciliation and set operations across taxonomic databases.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.check: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run knip && pnpm run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && effect-tsgo diagnostics --project tsconfig.test.json --strict
